claims.claim: Once your host account is created, open the [host setup page](https://cloud.vast.ai/host/setup/). There is a link in the first paragraph to the hosting agreement. Read through the agreement. Once you accept, your account is converted to a hosting account, and a Machines link appears in the navigation. Your account can now list machines that are running the daemon software.

claims.claim: Confirm that you are signed into the correct dedicated host account, then refresh or sign out and back in. If the Machines tab is still missing, treat it as an account-state issue rather than a Linux install issue. Contact Vast support with the host account email and screenshots or error messages from the setup flow.

claims.claim: Copy the install command only from the official setup page while signed into the host account. See [Installing Host Software](/host/installing-host-software#install-command).
